title: When AIs Judge AIs: The Rise of Agent-as-a-Judge Evaluation for LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature that evaluates whether LLM judges disproportionately favor text, responses, or arguments generated by themselves or by models sharing the same underlying architectural backbone.
Surveying research that tests if LLM evaluators exhibit a systemic preference for longer responses, awarding higher scores based on verbosity rather than actual quality.
Discussing studies that identify LLM judges' inherent preferences for certain familiar writing styles, formats, or tones that resemble their own training data.
